Policy Solution: Promote public transport instead of expanding motorways.
Reject higher parking fees (reduce them instead) and stop cuts to parking spaces.
Give Swiss quality products priority over cheap imports on the Swiss market.
Introduce mandatory labelling of foods containing GMO components.
End the tax and AHV discrimination against married and registered couples.
Open marriage to same-sex couples, including access to reproductive medicine.
Protect children's sexual integrity from pornography and the sex industry.
Rethink the penal system: less therapy, more punishment.
Invite religious organisations to sign the Charter of Religious Communities as a binding commitment to the rule of law and human rights.
Keep and teach the current national anthem in public schools.
Reduce administrative burden and over-regulation, especially for SMEs.
Award public contracts only to Swiss firms registered in the sector for at least 5 years.
Promote MINT/STEM fields among young people and women.
Find a long-term solution for exchange of students and researchers (successor to Erasmus).
Expand solar energy in particular.
Keep the current proven electricity mix and reject early shutdown of existing nuclear plants.
From 2030, invest no more Swiss money in the development of fossil fuels.
Oblige pension funds to divest shares of coal, gas and oil companies within five years.
Reform the withholding tax so that corporate financing in Switzerland becomes attractive again.
Keep cash in Switzerland as a means of payment and oppose forced conversion to purely electronic money.
Conduct regular, comprehensive task reviews to cut superfluous administrative tasks and units.
Reduce federal personnel to the 2015 level and massively cut personnel expenditure.
Lower medicine prices and cut the price of generics.
Reject any increase of deductibles (franchises).
Continue the bilateral path with the EU and prevent termination of the bilateral treaties.
End Swiss financial support of UNRWA.
Introduce better dismissal protection for older workers.
Better use domestic labour potential to ease the skills shortage (older workers, working women).
Recognize and promote refugees' skills acquired abroad and significantly increase federal integration funds so refugees can earn money quickly.
Withdraw Swiss citizenship from naturalized persons who commit particularly serious crimes.
Abolish the civilian service and integrate those liable into the army or civil protection.
Stand for a non-aligned Switzerland with no further integration into NATO.
Renounce raising the number of signatures required for referendums and initiatives.
Reject a national inheritance tax.
Flatten the progression rates in taxation.
Provide more and cheaper external (family-supplementary) childcare.
Reject raising the AHV retirement age.
Rapidly expand the fibre-optic and 5G mobile networks to maintain a technological lead.
Reject the introduction of e-voting in Switzerland.
